patthana19.7:1.1: na pītisahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cattāri.
patthana19.7:2.1: na sukhasahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sukhasahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cattāri.
patthana19.7:3.1: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upekkhāsahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na upekkhāsahagataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca pītisahagato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: cattāri. hetuyā aṭṭhavīsa. nadassanattike dassanattikaṃ na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na dassanena pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. saṅkhittaṃ.
